description: Functional specification/files: extend Zaq.Agent.ErrorMessage and the existing credential/runtime propagation boundary so public failures retain an allowlisted category, retryability and trusted personal/global provenance; cover required personal grant missing, invalid/revoked/expired/unavailable grants, OAuth refresh busy/failed, global credential missing, identity failures, provider auth/access, rate/quota/outage, oversized input, persistence/runtime/unknown failures. Never infer personal ownership from HTTP status alone; redact raw provider bodies, credential/grant IDs and secrets. Tests before implementation: error_message and Executor/Pipeline mapping tests, wrapped-reason tests, unknown fallback, and property tests proving secret/provider-body non-disclosure. Branches: pre-request denial, provider response, transient/permanent refresh, fallback and nested errors. Mocking: external provider errors only; internal boundaries real. Docs: Agent and Channels service error-contract sections. Action reuse: EXTEND lib/zaq/agent/error_message.ex and existing CredentialResolver/Executor contracts; no new Action/tool because classification is a local presentation concern. Preserve current callers and side effects; verify all consumers share the canonical formatter. Coordinate with zaq-jrg.34 refresh diagnostics without duplicating its producer logic.

comments.text: Implemented and validated in the working tree, pending authorization to commit/close. Added canonical actionable credential/provider messages, trusted selected-grant owner_type provenance, safe public reason/recovery/retry metadata, and removed raw credential IDs/provider bodies from outgoing error metadata. Added ingress and resolver regression/property coverage; updated Agent/Channels/System Config contracts. Validation passed: error-message + Executor suites (93 tests, 6 properties, 6 doctests), full Connect + Factory suites (465 tests, 11 properties), Mattermost Person credential ingress (8 tests), Serena diagnostics clean, mix q passed, git diff --check clean. No login/redirection changes. Next issue zaq-jrg.48 remains blocked until this issue is committed and closed.
Follow-up correction completed in the same working tree: personal recovery now renders an actual channel link rather than only a recovery category. No login or post-login redirection code changed.
